gloss: appearance on the market; circulation; availability

definitions.gloss: appearance on the market; availability; circulation of goods
definitions.explanation: The state of products, especially seasonal foods, becoming widely available in stores and markets.

examples.japanese: いちごの{出回|でまわ}りが{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: Strawberries have started appearing in stores.

examples.japanese: {新米|しんまい}の{出回|でまわ}る{時期|じき}だ。
examples.english: It's the season when new rice hits the market.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{暖冬|だんとう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{野菜|やさい}の{出回|でまわ}りが{早|はや}い。
examples.english: Vegetables are appearing on the market earlier this year due to the mild winter.

notes:
The noun form of {出回|でまわ}る (to appear on the market, to be in circulation). Commonly used to discuss seasonal availability of foods, especially fruits, vegetables, and fish.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出回|でまわ}りが{早|はや}い: appearing on the market early
- {出回|でまわ}りの{時期|じき}: the time when something appears in stores
- {出回|でまわ}り{量|りょう}: the quantity available on the market
- {市場|しじょう}に{出回|でまわ}る: to appear on the market

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {流通|りゅうつう}: distribution, circulation — broader term for the movement of goods through supply chains
- {旬|しゅん}: in season — refers to the peak season for a food item
